category_decisions.rationale: Modern infection-associated organ dysfunction explicitly distinct from postpartum local infections, with source diagnosis/control, pathogen branches and14-dimensional care.

dispute_adjudication.resolution: SMFM modern maternal sepsis and WHO2015 peripartum infection scopes are kept distinct. Local antimicrobial/fluid protocols vary; no universal regimen or dose. MSF48h fever diagnostic wording is not a delay instruction; emergency deterioration acts immediately.
